moduleDesc.geaDam: Enterprise DAM with online preview for 80+ formats and AI-powered parsing and search, plus version control, comments and annotations, and multi-level permissions across departments and groups
moduleDesc.geaContext: Enterprise agent OS and context system for orchestrating Agents, Skills, Connectors, and scheduled routines, with LLM compilation of enterprise knowledge, layered knowledge-tree management, and end-to-end governance of permissions, audit, and usage
moduleDesc.coldHotStorage: Recommended when storage volume is large; unlock separate hot and cold capacity configuration
moduleDesc.multiRegionStorage: For strong cross-border compliance needs; enables independent overseas hot/cold storage buckets
moduleDesc.customSystemHomepage: Customize the branded workspace homepage, including navigation layout, welcome message, recommended sections, frequently used link entries, and content panels such as popular assets and recently viewed
moduleDesc.smartFolders: Automatically collect matching assets by preset rules and keep them updated as new files arrive; members only see assets they can access, with folder visibility and external sharing controlled separately
moduleDesc.customMetadataFields: Extend asset attributes to match your organization's taxonomy, with text, single-select, multi-select, people, date, number, and hyperlink fields. Up to 300 fields per system, unlimited assets
moduleDesc.assetAnalytics: Track reuse rate, usage frequency, lifecycle, and other core metrics, with analysis by asset, project, and department to identify high-value and idle assets and quantify content ROI
moduleDesc.brandLibrary: A unified hub for brand strategy and visual systems, capturing positioning, tone, logo, color, type, and packaging guidelines; can be extracted from brand books and used as brand context for AI generation
moduleDesc.productLibrary: Centrally manage product names, SKUs, brands, status, and multi-level categories. Products and assets are linked, with multi-dimensional search and Excel/CSV bulk import/export
moduleDesc.projectHub: Manage the full project lifecycle with kanban, Gantt, and asset views. Stages can be customized, with assignee and progress tracking so status stays visible
moduleDesc.aiAutoTag: Auto-tag against your multi-level taxonomy using image/text recognition and path keywords, with auto and human-review modes, confidence scores, and policy controls
moduleDesc.featureBrand: Build a visual feature library from logo and trademark samples so AI can detect brand marks in assets and apply matching tags
moduleDesc.featureProduct: Build a visual feature library from multi-angle product shots and packaging so AI can detect products in assets and apply matching tags
moduleDesc.featurePerson: Build a facial feature library from photos of spokespersons and brand ambassadors so AI can detect people in assets and apply matching tags
moduleDesc.featureIp: Build a visual feature library from multi-pose IP character art so AI can detect IP characters in assets and apply matching tags, with whole-look and local-feature matching
moduleDesc.aiFeatureRecognition: AI automatically detects and clusters people, IP characters, and product features in assets, with results shown on the asset and available to name and correct—no sample setup required
moduleDesc.museAIBasic: An AI creation workspace driven by a design Agent, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and keyframe video, plus a layered editable canvas and template tools; includes 50,000 AI compute points
moduleDesc.museAIStandard: An AI creation workspace driven by a design Agent, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and keyframe video, plus a layered editable canvas and template tools; includes 100,000 AI compute points and an industry prompt template library
moduleDesc.museAIAdvanced: An AI creation workspace driven by a design Agent, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and keyframe video, plus a layered editable canvas and template tools; includes 200,000 AI compute points, an industry prompt template library, branded gallery management, and project edit/view-only permissions
moduleDesc.batchTemplating: Generate finished creatives in bulk from structured templates and spreadsheet data, with element-level editing, multi-layout exploration, automatic size variants across channels, and layered PSD workflows
moduleDesc.professionalPrint: Supports print settings, color management, printer marks, and compliant print-ready output
moduleDesc.htmlExport: Convert designs into channel-ready HTML with responsive adaptation
moduleDesc.clipoRemixBee: An AI video production workspace covering script, storyboard, voiceover/music, and compositing, with batch remix, template reuse, and multilingual digital-human voiceover; includes 50,000 AI compute points and 1TB
moduleDesc.clipoRemixPanda: An AI video production workspace covering script, storyboard, voiceover/music, and compositing, with batch remix, template reuse, and multilingual digital-human voiceover; includes 140,000 AI compute points and 5TB
moduleDesc.clipoRemixLion: An AI video production workspace covering script, storyboard, voiceover/music, and compositing, with batch remix, template reuse, and multilingual digital-human voiceover; includes 340,000 AI compute points and 10TB
moduleDesc.fileCollection: Generate an external intake link under a specified folder so outsiders can upload without an account. Files land in that folder automatically, with expiry and password controls
moduleDesc.approvalCenter: An internal approval hub with templated workflows, multi-level online review, bulk or item-level asset marking, full audit trail, and automatic result routing
moduleDesc.deliveryApprovalCenter: A deliverable acceptance flow for external vendors and agencies, with custom approval flows, bulk submit, markup feedback, version history, SLA timeout handoff, and auto-ingest on approval
moduleDesc.taskWorkflowBasic: End-to-end creative-request management covering intake, scheduling, assignment, and tracking, with kanban, Gantt, list, and calendar views plus role-based permissions
moduleDesc.taskWorkflowAdvanced: An integrated production hub from marketing planning to content delivery, covering marketing calendar, request intake, project management, scheduling and resource allocation, task collaboration, and process rules
moduleDesc.automationCenter: Automatically move and process assets by preset rules using trigger + action configuration, replacing repetitive manual work, with a full run history
moduleDesc.complianceCheck: Detect advertising-language risk against advertising law and related regulations, flag sensitive content in images and video (adult, violence, politics, discrimination, religion, etc.), and overlay enterprise custom dictionaries
moduleDesc.complianceEu: Extends Compliance Check with EU advertising rules to flag prohibited and restricted claims under local regulations
moduleDesc.complianceUs: Extends Compliance Check with US advertising rules to flag prohibited and restricted claims under local regulations
moduleDesc.brandComplianceAgent: Automatically checks visual and copy compliance against Brand Library guidelines, with issue location and revision suggestions
moduleDesc.storeInspectionAgent: Automatically identifies display and installation of in-store materials from on-site photos, compares against execution standards, and outputs inspection results
moduleDesc.copyrightManagement: Centrally manage rights agreements and licenses, set asset availability by region, channel, and term, and automatically restrict sharing and download on expiry to reduce infringement risk
moduleDesc.watermark: Site-wide watermarking that applies consistently in preview and sharing; watermark copy and style are customizable
moduleDesc.publicAssetsAndDerivatives: Auto-generate multi-spec derivatives and public links by preset rules, with folder-level permissions, bulk link export, and API integration; includes 300GB CDN traffic per month
moduleDesc.dat: Output assets in specified formats and sizes in real time via URL parameters, without pre-generation, with preset templates and API calls
moduleDesc.portal: A branded asset portal for external audiences, with role-based sites, custom branding and content layout, visitor identification, personalized content, and download authorization
moduleDesc.portalTheme: Custom portal theme aligned to brand visuals, covering list and detail pages
moduleDesc.socialArticle: Create and edit WeChat Official Account articles in-platform, with layout, asset reuse, and publish-status management
moduleDesc.socialAccountPack: Expand social account binding quota on top of existing allowance: 50 accounts/pack/year
moduleDesc.socialAttribution: Aggregate impressions and engagement of published content across platforms, trace back to source assets, and quantify performance
moduleDesc.ecomAccountPack: Expand e-commerce account binding quota on top of existing allowance: 50 accounts/pack/year
moduleDesc.ecomAttribution: Aggregate impressions and conversion of published products across platforms, trace back to source assets, and quantify performance
moduleDesc.feishuDrive.basic: Import Feishu Drive file links into DAM and present them as cards in the asset library
moduleDesc.feishuDrive.advanced: Import Feishu cloud-doc links, automatically extract text, images, video, and attachments, and split them into independently managed composite assets
moduleDesc.feishuBitable.oneWay: One-way sync DAM custom metadata fields such as project status to a specified Feishu Bitable for viewing and reporting in Feishu
moduleDesc.feishuBitable.twoWay: Sync DAM custom metadata such as project status to Feishu Bitable; designated fields can be updated in the table and written back, with write-back scope and permissions set by admins
moduleDesc.feishuApproval: Sync in-app approvals to Feishu to-dos so reviewers can act in Feishu; results write back and update approval, asset, and task status
moduleDesc.cdnTraffic: Can be purchased with public links; flexible top-up when consumed during the service period
moduleDesc.cdnGlobal: Supports download and preview of all files, and upload of regular-sized files
moduleDesc.GA: For demanding cross-border collaboration, ensuring large overseas file uploads
moduleDesc.customerService: Dedicated ticketing, response within 1–2 business days
moduleDesc.professionalServices: Product version updates and feature upgrades during the term, weekday 8-hour dedicated support and success team, and 2 enterprise trainings per year
moduleDesc.featureLibrary: Build a visual feature library from samples such as logos, products, people, and IP characters so AI can detect matching objects in assets and apply tags
moduleDesc.socialChannels: One-stop publishing to major social platforms, with multi-cut variants, native-style preview, and scheduled posts
moduleDesc.ecomChannels: Distribute product assets to major e-commerce platforms in one place, with platform-spec adaptation, bulk listing, and publishing
moduleDesc.regionalCompliance: Extends Compliance Check with selected regional advertising rules to flag prohibited and restricted claims under local regulations
moduleDesc.enterpriseSSO: Enterprise SSO, supporting SAML / Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk / Microsoft Teams, and more
moduleDesc.taskWorkflow: End-to-end creative-request management covering intake, scheduling, assignment, and tracking, with kanban, Gantt, list, and calendar views plus role-based permissions
moduleDesc.aiAutoTagModule: Auto-tag against your multi-level taxonomy using image/text recognition and path keywords, with auto and human-review modes, confidence scores, and policy controls

moduleDesc.feishuBitable: One-way sync DAM custom metadata fields such as project status to a specified Feishu Bitable for viewing and reporting in Feishu
